answer_1.quote: When conducting an evaluation to rank natural language generation (NLG) systems, including modern "generative AI" systems, the goal is to reliably recover the "true" ranking of the systems by quality on the tasks/domains of interest.
answer_1.outputs: segment-level translations in English-German and English-Chinese

answer_4.quote: human evaluation remains the best way to do this. However, human raters can exhibit different behaviors when rating NLG outputs.
answer_4.guideline: raters identify error spans within translations, which are automatically converted to numeric scores based on hierarchical category (e.g. Fluency/Grammar or Accuracy/Mistranslation) and severity (Major or Minor)
